# csv-parser

Vendored from [vincentlaucsb/csv-parser](https://github.com/vincentlaucsb/csv-parser), release 2.3.0.

`csv.h` is the single header the release ships. It is not edited here, so it
can be replaced with a newer release by overwriting the one file. The MIT
licence text is in the header itself and the entry in
`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` points at it.

Only `benchmark/` uses it, to read the texts, patterns and labels of a
directory corpus.
